faqs.question: Are Facebook Ads still effective for Texas businesses after iOS privacy updates?
faqs.answer: Yes, they remain highly effective. However, the technical implementation must adapt. We bypass browser-level blocking by configuring Meta's Conversions API (CAPI) on a secure server-side tracking layer. This feeds Meta's machine learning algorithm with accurate purchase and lead data, allowing it to optimize target audience delivery and maintain a low Cost-Per-Acquisition.

faqs.question: What is a realistic starting budget for Facebook Ads in Texas?
faqs.answer: We recommend a starting budget of at least $1,500 to $3,000 per month in direct media spend. This budget ensures that the Meta algorithm receives enough conversion data daily (the platform requires roughly 50 conversion events per week per ad set) to exit the initial 'learning phase' and stabilize delivery costs quickly.

faqs.question: Do you produce all of the ad copy, images, and videos in-house?
faqs.answer: Yes. GrowLimo provides full-service creative production. Our team designs scroll-stopping static graphics, dynamic carousels, and writes custom scripts for vertical video ads (Reels and Stories). We construct and A/B test a minimum of 3-5 distinct creative variations per ad campaign to combat ad fatigue and maintain consistent lead acquisition rates.

faqs.question: How quickly will we start receiving leads and sales after launch?
faqs.answer: Meta ads are a demand-creation channel that delivers immediate visibility. Most campaigns generate initial lead form submissions or eCommerce sales within 24 to 48 hours of going live. Over the first 30 days, campaign efficiency improves as we gather conversion data, test creative variations, and optimize target audience parameters.

faqs.question: Can you target specific Texas cities, suburbs, and zip codes?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We build geo-fenced campaigns using specific mile-radius boundaries around your business locations or target specific lists of high-value zip codes. This is highly effective for local service businesses in sprawling metroplexes like Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, Austin, and San Antonio, ensuring you only pay to reach customers within your service territory.

faqs.question: How do we receive and contact the leads generated by Facebook?
faqs.answer: We integrate your Meta Lead Forms directly with your sales pipeline or CRM software (such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or GoHighLevel) via secure APIs. When a prospect submits their details, your team receives an instant email/SMS notification. We also construct automated auto-responder campaigns to contact new leads immediately.

faqs.question: How do you define and track campaign success?
faqs.answer: We ignore vanity metrics like post engagement, page likes, and impressions. We define and optimize campaigns based on bottom-line business metrics: cost-per-lead, cost-per-acquisition, total booked appointments, sales conversion rate, and overall marketing return on investment (ROI/ROAS). Every metric is visible in a transparent, live dashboard.

faqs.question: Does GrowLimo require a long-term contract for ad management?
faqs.answer: No. We offer our Facebook Ads management service in Texas on a flexible, month-to-month basis. We believe in earning your business through monthly performance, not binding contracts. We suggest a minimum of a 90-day testing window to allow the campaigns to fully optimize, but you are free to cancel at any time with a 30-day notice.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Google Ads and Facebook Ads for Texas businesses?
faqs.answer: Google Ads targets active search intent—users searching for specific keywords. Facebook Ads targets interest, demographic, and behavioral profiles to create demand before users search. A mature marketing system combines both: Facebook Ads to build brand awareness and attract passive prospects, and Google Ads to capture active search demand.

faqs.question: How do you prevent ad fatigue in active campaigns?
faqs.answer: Ad fatigue occurs when target audiences are shown the same creative too many times, leading to a drop in CTR and a spike in CPA. We prevent this by actively monitoring ad frequency. We systematically rotate new image designs, vertical video clips, and copy variations into active ad sets every 7 to 14 days, pausing fatigued assets.
